name: What factors determine the cost of a drywall repair project?
description: Cost depends on damage size, location (walls vs. high ceilings), whether framing backing must be added, and the labor required to match existing textures.

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of a drywall repair project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall repair costs depend primarily on the damage size, wall height, backing requirements, and whether the surface has a custom texture. A small puncture from a doorknob requires minimal material and labor, keeping costs low. Large ceiling holes, deep plumbing access cuts, or water-damaged sections requiring structural backing and texture blending take more time and specialized labor, increasing the total expense. Requesting an on-site evaluation ensures an accurate scope before work begins.
